method: Whole-file manual reading of Portuguese catalog; pinned bytes reverified; automated structural evidence retained separately.
findings: Duplicados prováveis, Prefixo de hash and Hash por amostragem preserve probability/prefix/sampling distinctions. Advanced sampling caption says hashes esparsos above64MiB: describes sparse sampling, not sparse-file equality qualification.

Recovery completion requests verifying file data, candidate status remains conditional, metadata changes request rescan and same-volume restoration warns it may replace deleted data. No disk recovery proof inferred.

Catalog mixes European ficheiros/guardar with Brazilian arquivos/salvar while MSI declares pt-PT. Some action descriptions retain English Delete, Command Prompt and Open; consistency issue, not a library algorithm defect.
Show stripes is translated Exibir Listas, which can imply lists rather than alternating stripes; component store becomes loja de componentes. These are terminology findings without rendered UI tests.
Sparsify is explicitly Tornar arquivo esparso, separate from compression; hardlinks, symbolic links, junctions and logical/physical sizes retain separate labels.
Operation confirmation keeps formatted operation field; custom cleanup retains %p/%n/%sp/%sn. Runtime expansion, keyboard mnemonics and installer encoding are not proven by text parity.
limits: No Portuguese Windows UI, rendering, installer or keyboard qualification. No foreign production code adopted.
Native pHash investigation deferred; completed repository count remains147/500.
